samir: Heads up — our nightly SBOM scan flagged OpenSSL soname changes in the alpine base we ship. Looks like libssl moved to 3.1.x in the new upstream which will change the soname. This can break image promotion and the image-signer -> KMS attestation step.
jena: ugh. where did it surface? which tag? can you paste the `docker inspect` / package list? :eyes: 
samir: image: redwood/base:alpine-2026-03-10. Output:```/lib/libssl.so.3 -> libssl.so.3.1.0``` and dpkg-style list via `apk info -v | grep openssl` shows 3.1.0-r0.
devin: that version bump is in the upstream alpine sec mirror. Might be an autopush from the distro CI. Did the image pass our signer/attestation pipeline?
samir: It did — signer produced attestation but verification on prod clusters failed during canary promotion with linker errors. Error in prod-perf job: `error while loading shared libraries: libssl.so.3: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory` — looks like some runtime nodes still have libssl.so.1.1 from older images.
maria: Two immediate concerns: (1) rebuild/tag to maintain previous soname (pin openssl pkg) or provide compat symlink in image, (2) ensure KMS key policy + signer RBAC won't allow unsigned or mismatched-soname images to be promoted. We should also capture this in audit logs so we can trace which commit introduced the new base.
jena: For KMS/signing RBAC — current signer role (roles/image-signer) has ability to call KMS:Encrypt for envelope keys and to write to artifact registry. If we start doing transient rebuilds that add symlinks, we need to ensure CI ephemeral keys are allowed but revoke after use. We should avoid expanding permissions.
devin: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) patch image to add `/usr/lib/compat/libssl.so.1.1 -> /lib/libssl.so.3` symlink? (risky), 2) pin openssl package to previous minor via `apk add openssl=3.0.7-r0`, 3) gate promotion with an extra runtime link check in the canary job (fail if soname mismatch). Thoughts?
maria: I prefer pinning for now and triggering a deliberate compatibility upgrade window. Add a gating check to the promotion pipeline that runs `ldd` on our core binaries and verifies required sonames exist.
security-oncall: Also log an audit event for every signer invocation that includes base image digest, package list hash, and KMS key id. If we don't already record package list in attestation, add it. That will let us forensically link the image -> base change -> promotion.
samir: Agree. I'll open a small PR to pin openssl in the base Dockerfile and add the `ldd` gating step. I'll also emit an attestation predicate with `apk info -v` output.
jena: Can you include the KMS key ID in the attestation envelope? Our current signer records artifact digest and build metadata but not package list nor key id.
devin: Adding key id is fine but check KMS logs — we already have KMS audit logs in CAS for Encrypt calls. Attestation will make it easier. Make sure we don't leak KMS key material in attestation (only key id).
image-signer-bot: deploybot: signer v2.9 deployed to ci, now emitting attestation predicate field `pkg_list_hash` and `kms_key_id` on successful sign. :white_check_mark:
maria: Next steps: (1) samir pin & PR, (2) devex add promotion gate + ldd check (+ test matrix for amd64/arm64), (3) security add attestation + update audit retention policy to keep these events 1y, (4) ops roll fast canary to isolated perf cluster before global rollout. Assigning owners: samir->base-image PR, devin->promotion gate + tests, jena->kms/audit policy, maria->canary coord.
samir: I'll create the PR now and tag reviewers. Will include repro notes and the failing log lines.
jena: thanks. once PR is up please ping #eng-oncall and add `security-oncall` as reviewer. We'll want to schedule a 30m triage if the canary shows any regressions. :calendar:
